evals.prompt: I'm picking envsetup back up. Where are we, and what should I do first?
evals.expected_output: A brief (under 1,600 characters) in the skill's template — released version, unreleased on main, parked branches, open/unverified items, the proposed next item and its first step, a Session line, a 'read in full:' line. The message is a question, so the Session line may say none (nothing to record yet) — then no file is created; if the run opens one instead, exactly one new docs/sessions/SES-NNN with Status: open and its Goal set; either way nothing else on disk changes except the regenerated sessions index.
expectations: brief.md is under 1,600 characters (wc -c) and states the released version v0.1.9
brief.md names what is on main but unreleased and the parked branch wip/visual-grouping

brief.md contains a line starting with 'read in full:' that names docs/OVERVIEW.md, CONTEXT.md and the newest SES file, and transcript.md shows each of those was read to its last line (a second read with offset where the tool truncated)

The brief's Session line states one of the three outcomes and the disk agrees: the message is a question and the run changes nothing, so `none` is the correct outcome (no new docs/sessions file; session-file.md says so); `opened` is acceptable only if the run took work (exactly one new SES-NNN with `- Status: open` and its Goal filled); `joined` fails unless the run will record entries into that session AND no other conversation owns it — a session with another conversation's unfilled placeholders is never joined, whatever its title says

git-state.txt shows HEAD unchanged from the fixture tip and nothing modified under docs/sessions/ other than the new file and README.md (the regenerated index) — in particular SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched

brief.md reports the state of the tree and the sessions as findings (branch name; every session `bun run session list` reports open, named; that another conversation's open session — SES-005 in these fixtures — has placeholders that are not this conversation's to fill) rather than fixing anything, and proposes a concrete next item with a first step that respects the previous session's Open at end
transcript.md shows no push, no PR, no commit

Every fact the brief states is true at the end of the run: the released sha matches `git rev-parse --short vX.Y.Z`, the parked branch exists where the brief says it does (local vs origin), and every file on the read-in-full line has a transcript step whose line range reaches the file's last line (`wc -l`)

evals.prompt: I just committed the fix for the stale set-favorites.swift asset (it now matches the embedded constant). Record it properly before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: A docs(session) commit on HEAD whose entry for the fix commit has Summary, Why, a specific phrase per touched file (naming --list / LSSharedFileListItemCopyResolvedURL for the Swift file) and Notes saying how the claim was verified; OVERVIEW Next-up 5 and the two finder docs that called the asset stale updated; `bun run session check` prints session: complete; SES-005 untouched.
expectations: commit.diff shows HEAD is a commit whose subject starts with docs(session): and the fix(finder) commit is an ancestor

session-file.md holds an entry for the fix(finder) commit whose src/items/finder/assets/set-favorites.swift line mentions --list or LSSharedFileListItemCopyResolvedURL (a specific phrase, not 'updated')
session-file.md's entry Notes state how the fix's claim was verified (a driver run, a byte comparison or swiftc), and transcript.md shows that verification command was actually run
git-state.txt shows `bun run session check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
overview.diff shows docs/OVERVIEW.md Next-up 5 no longer lists the stale set-favorites.swift asset (removed or marked done, citing the fix commit)
commit.diff shows src/items/finder/CLAUDE.md and src/items/finder/.claude/skills/run-src-items-finder/SKILL.md no longer say the asset is stale
commit.diff does not touch docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md, and transcript.md shows files were staged by name (no `git add -A` / `git add .`)

evals.prompt: That's it — the review found nothing to fix, so this one is done. Close it out.
evals.expected_output: The session's Goal is met, so this is `close`: Outcome and Open at end written, `bun run session close --session SES-006` run after a green gate (Status: closed), OVERVIEW Status/Next up checked (changed only if reality changed), a clean tree on main or every exception named, SES-005 untouched, and a closing note of at most 60 words: what shipped and the first thing to do next time.
expectations: session-file.md has Outcome and Open at end written (no _(fill in)_ on either line), `- Status: closed`, and its Narrative mentions this closing; git-state.txt or transcript.md shows `bun run session close --session SES-006` printing `session: closed SES-006`
git-state.txt shows `bun run session check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
reply.md is at most 60 words and states what shipped in the conversation and the first thing to do next time
overview.diff is 'no change', or changes only Status/Next up with a reason in transcript.md grounded in this conversation's own work (not in fixture scaffolding commits)
docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched (git-state.txt / commit shows no change to it) and no second session file was created
transcript.md shows no push, no PR opened, no merge

Every read, review or verification that the session file's Outcome / Open at end / Narrative and the reply's Shipped line attribute to this conversation appears as a step in transcript.md (a file named as read has a Read/cat step reaching its end; a check named as run has its command and output); a claim with no transcript step fails this expectation, and so does a count or sha that `git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD` / `git log` contradicts at the end of the run

evals.prompt: Done for today. The docs review still has the ADR pass to go, so this session isn't finished — leave it open and write the handoff.
evals.expected_output: The session's Goal is unmet, so this is `end` (leave): the log complete, Open at end written as the handoff (the ADR pass first), the Narrative whole, the handoff committed as docs(session), Status still open, Outcome still its placeholder, OVERVIEW checked, a clean tree, SES-005 untouched, and a closing note of at most 60 words ending with (SES-006 stays open).
expectations: session-file.md has `- Status: open`, `- Outcome: _(fill in)_` still in place, and `Open at end` written (no placeholder) naming the ADR pass as what the next conversation picks up first

git-state.txt shows HEAD is a commit whose subject starts with docs(session): touching docs/sessions/SES-006-closing-eval.md (and the regenerated README.md index), and `bun run session check --session SES-006` printing session: complete (SES-006, open)
reply.md is at most 60 words, states what shipped and the first thing to do next time, and says the session stays open
transcript.md shows no `bun run session close` and no push, PR or merge; docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched

Every read, review or verification that the session file's Outcome / Open at end / Narrative and the reply's Shipped line attribute to this conversation appears as a step in transcript.md (a file named as read has a Read/cat step reaching its end; a check named as run has its command and output); a claim with no transcript step fails this expectation, and so does a count or sha that `git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD` / `git log` contradicts at the end of the run
